usage: Use 淺粉紅色 to describe a very soft pink colour, often for clothes or accessories. 呢件衫係淺粉紅色。
It can be used before nouns to describe an object’s colour. 我買咗個淺粉紅色袋。
You can use it when talking about paint or interior design. 牆身想油淺粉紅色。
It also works for things like phone cases, stationery, or decorations. 我支筆盒係淺粉紅色。
